## Installation notes

- Download `ClipVault_<version>_x64-setup.exe` below and run it.
- Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" for new
  releases: click **More info → Run anyway**. This app is unsigned;
  verify the SHA256 checksum in `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want certainty.
- Upgrade installs keep all history and settings.
